name: Giggs
description:
'''Jason Neville''' "'''Nathaniel'''" '''Thompson''' (born 11 May 1981), known professionally as '''Giggs''', is a British rapper from [[Peckham]], [[London]]. He self-released his debut studio album ''[[Walk in da Park]]'' (2008), and signed with [[Takeover Entertainment]] to release its follow-up ''[[Let Em Ave It]]'' (2009).

Giggs' third studio album ''When Will It Stop'' (2013), was followed by his fourth album ''[[Landlord (album)|Landlord]]'' (2016), which entered and peaked at number 2 on the [[UK Albums Chart]] – becoming the highest-charting album of his career, tied with his mixtape ''[[Wamp 2 Dem]]'' (2017), which also debuted at No. 2. It was followed by his fifth album, ''Now or Never'' (2020). Giggs is also the frontman and founder of record label and rap collective SN1 (Spare No 1), which includes Gunna Dee, Joe Grind, Kyze and Tiny Boost.

While often referred to as a [[Grime (music genre)|grime]] MC, Giggs has repeatedly stated the music he makes is not grime, but rather falls under the [[Road rap|UK rap]] umbrella.
